headline: All four down on Friday; Binance hack still weighing on crypto

BTC.note: Binance hack overhang; withdrawals due back ~Sun 1 Nov

MSTR.note: MSCI index exclusion list due 11 Nov

parts.fundamentals: Mixed: US spot ETFs -US$516m in Oct (-US$202m week to 30 Oct); hash rate record ~1,064 EH/s; adoption/regulation not checked (2/4)

reasons.fundamentals: Mixed (2/4). Money into US spot Bitcoin ETFs turned negative: about US$515m out in October and US$202m out in the week to 30 Oct, including US$643m out on Fri 30 Oct, the biggest one-day exit since June. The network itself is healthy: hash rate hit a record of about 1,064 EH/s (24 Oct), and miners kept adding capacity while the price fell. Adoption and regulation news: Not verified this round.
reasons.news: Watch (2/3). Binance, an exchange, lost about US$6.3bn in a hack on 29-30 Oct. It was not a flaw in Bitcoin. Withdrawals are due back around Sun 1 Nov and proof-of-reserves results on Mon 2 Nov. The risk is the attacker selling the stolen BTC.
reasons.growth: Mixed (2/3). Price is below its 50-day average but above its 200-day average. Weekly RSI is in the normal 35-70 range.

sources.label: US spot Bitcoin ETF flows, Oct 2026 (TFTC / Farside)

parts.fundamentals: Good: Q3 beat on EPS (48c vs 45c) and revenue (US$28.05bn), positive free cash flow, capex cut; but net income down, energy missed (3/4)

reasons.fundamentals: Good (3/4). Q3 2026 (reported 21 Oct) beat forecasts: adjusted EPS 48c vs about 45c expected, and revenue US$28.05bn vs about US$27.9bn. Free cash flow was positive at US$1.53bn and the 2026 capex plan was cut to about US$20bn. Car margins beat estimates and the order backlog is the biggest in four years. Weak spots: net income fell about 29-43% (sources differ on basis), car revenue fell 3%, and energy revenue missed. Not Strong because profit fell.
reasons.news: Nothing material (3/3). No confirmed Tesla breach; a September forum claim is unverified.
reasons.growth: On track (3/3). Price is above both its 50-day and 200-day averages, and weekly RSI is in the normal 35-70 range.

sources.label: Tesla Q3 call and capex (Reuters via Investing.com)

parts.fundamentals: Mixed: Q3 BTC holdings 848,517 (+26% YTD), US$21bn raised, low leverage; but BTC Yield -3.7% YTD, mNAV ~1.15x (2/4)
parts.news: MSCI exclusion list due 11 Nov, watch (2/3)

reasons.fundamentals: Mixed (2/4). Q3 2026 (reported 29 Oct): holds 848,517 BTC, up 26% this year, after raising US$21.2bn this year (US$5.4bn in Q3 from share sales). Net leverage fell to about 2.4%, with US$5.07bn of cash reserves covering 3.4 years of dividends and interest. But BTC Yield, the bitcoin per share, is -3.7% this year, meaning new shares diluted holders faster than bitcoin was added. The premium to its bitcoin (mNAV) is thin at about 1.15x. The record US$19.5bn profit is mostly a paper gain on bitcoin's price.
reasons.news: Watch (2/3). The MSCI index exclusion list is due 11 Nov and could force some funds to sell. No breach at Strategy itself.
reasons.growth: Behind (1/3). Price is below both its 50-day and 200-day averages. Weekly RSI is in the normal range.

reasons.news: Nothing material (3/3). No breaches at the top holdings; NVIDIA's July software bug was patched.
reasons.growth: Mixed (2/3). Price is below its 50-day average but above its 200-day average. Weekly RSI is in the normal range.
